reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing getBulkBudgetCategories for the averages and setLastMonthSpending, but leaves setZero on its own copy of that query instead of routing it through the helper.

duplication.why: The same conditional hidden clause is written twice in SQL (getBulkBudgetCategories and setZero's identical copy of it) and a third time as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: All changes stay in server/budget/actions.ts with the month-wide actions; the flag sits in the shared selection for most actions, but setZero and copyPreviousMonth decide it locally.

scope.why: Only the flag on the month-wide actions and one test; the BulkBudgetActionOptions type is a small, related tidy-up.

maintainability.why: Workable, but the hidden rule is still decided in three places, so the next change to the selection must again be made in each.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts setZero keeps its own copy of getBulkBudgetCategories' SQL and patches the flag into it; copyPreviousMonth applies the flag in its own JS check.
